messages:
Customer_Acme: Hey team — after our IdP cert rotation at 02:00 UTC some users hit 403s when logging in via SSO. We see errors in our SP logs: 'Assertion recipient mismatch' and 'invalid signature chain'. Anyone seen this after a cert rollover?

Ivy (support): Sorry you're hit by this — can you paste the exact SAMLResponse log line and the ACS URL you're configured with? Also did you update IdP metadata to include the new cert? :eyes:

Customer_Acme: Log excerpt: `ERROR: saml: recipient mismatch: expected https://apps.acme.com/sso/acs, got https://apps.acme.com/sso/acs/` and `signature verification failed: certificate chain incomplete`

Eli (ops): Two quick things to check: 1) trailing slash on ACS can cause recipient mismatch depending on SP canonicalization, 2) IdP might be serving a chain missing intermediates. Can you share your IdP metadata URL?

Customer_Acme: Metadata URL is https://idp.partnercorp.com/metadata.xml — we rotated the cert and uploaded a new metadata blob yesterday. We validated the cert on their portal but didn't check intermediate chain.

Jen (eng): Can you run `curl -v https://idp.partnercorp.com/metadata.xml` from one of your SP instances and paste the TLS chain we see? Also check the EntityID in the metadata exactly matches the entityId your SP is using. Mismatches there will cause recipient/audience problems.

Customer_Acme: Pasting curl output snippet from one of our app nodes:

```
* Server certificate:
*  subject: CN=idp.partnercorp.com
*  start date: Mar  1 01:00:00 2026 GMT
*  expire date: Feb 28 01:00:00 2027 GMT
*  issuer: CN=Partner Intermediate CA
*  SSL certificate verify ok.
```

But our security team says the chain the IdP uploaded to the IdP portal had the intermediate missing, they patched it, but maybe the metadata the IdP serves is stale (cached).

Morgan (sre): If the SP cached the IdP metadata (many SPs poll on interval), you can force a refresh in console or hit the SP endpoint that triggers metadata reload. On our side we have a metadata poller with backoff — if metadata updated while the old cert still valid, we might still be using the old chain until next poll. Ivy, did we already escalate to Identity team to bump poller?

Ivy (support): Not yet — I'm opening an ops ticket now and pinging identity. Meanwhile Eli, can you try validating the exact Recipient/Audience check against both `https://apps.acme.com/sso/acs` and `https://apps.acme.com/sso/acs/`? We should be tolerant of trailing slash for migration.

Eli (ops): Quick repro I ran locally: our SP library compares the `Recipient` strictly against configured ACS. For now a config workaround: add the ACS variant with trailing slash to accepted recipients or canonicalize to always strip trailing slash before comparison. I can push a one-line tolerance patch.

Jen (eng): Patch looks fine but we should avoid changing validation semantics silently. Proposal: add an opt-in compatibility flag `allow_acs_trailing_slash=true` and document. For the current incident, we can hotfix the customer's running SP config to accept both forms.

Customer_Acme: We patched their SP config to accept both, and forced a metadata refresh on the SP. After that, login errors dropped to zero within 6 minutes. The IdP fixed the chained certs and now curl shows the full chain. :tada:

Ivy (support): Great! I'll mark this as "mitigated" and keep the ticket open until we confirm no regressions for 24h. Action items: 1) Ops to add temporary acceptance rule for ACS trailing slash (Eli), 2) Identity team to verify metadata TTL/polling and ensure intermediates included (Ivy -> Identity), 3) Docs: add note on ACS canonicalization and recommended SP config (Jen).

DevBot: Incident created: #INC-2026-4321 (Priority: P2) — assigned to Ivy, Eli, Jen.

Eli (ops): Done — pushed compatibility rule to the customer's SP and added a one-line comment. Will follow up with a proper code change in the next sprint for opt-in flag.

Jen (eng): I'll draft the docs blurb and add a short eval to our test harness that validates recipient matching with/without trailing slash to avoid regressions.

Customer_Acme: Thanks everyone, really appreciate the quick turnaround. Please share final RCA and any long-term config changes we should do on our side.

Ivy (support): Will do — initial RCA: immediate cause was twofold: IdP metadata briefly served without intermediate certs after rotation (causing signature verification errors) + strict ACS recipient comparison failed because the IdP's assertion used ACS with a trailing slash. Root cause: metadata propagation + strict SP canonicalization. Next steps included above. Closing once 24h clean. :white_check_mark:
